title: LPS structural reductions: duality, quartic obstruction, and p-adic certificates
oneLine: A complementary-minor duality compresses a growing Polydegree obstruction to a fixed-width flag, while repaired quartic and p-adic certificates expose the remaining uniform radical-membership target.
abstract: This anonymous, unrefereed three-manuscript candidate develops a structural route through the Lewis--Perry--Straub formulation of the Polydegree programme. A complementary-minor congruence, rigidity duality and inverse-coordinate descent compress the second radical-membership obstruction to an adjacent-flag transversality problem in fixed width. For d=5, an exact companion studies the resulting quartic geometry, separates centered and backward coefficient gauges, and proves only their localized bridge. A p-adic addendum gives a certificate theorem, a degeneration identity, twelve designated-prime instances through n=57 and an explicit n=15 exception to the designated reduced-gcd route. The package passes paired 20-check replay, mutation and fail-closed controls, a five-role internal review after repair and bounded confirmation. The uniform radical membership and slope-four law remain open. No target conjecture, independent reproduction, formal verification, external specialist review, peer review, novelty or priority is claimed.
narration: Five famous problems about polynomial maps are linked by known implication routes, but their common breakthrough remains elusive. This anonymous, unrefereed candidate does not claim that breakthrough. It makes one route smaller and more testable. The structural paper uses a complementary-minor duality to turn a family of equations whose size grows with the parameter into an adjacent-flag problem of fixed width. In the first coupled case, the surviving geometry has only four variables. The computational companion then studies that quartic obstruction exactly. A major repair distinguishes two coefficient gauges: a centered staircase gauge and a backward p-adic gauge. They agree only after localizing where an explicit transition determinant is invertible. The release also keeps two logical limits visible. Transversality can identify bad loci without proving that they are empty, and a pure leading monomial can prove zero-dimensionality without proving saturation. The p-adic addendum gives a separate positive signal. Twelve designated-prime cases through fifty-seven certify, while the index fifteen shows why the designated finite-field route can have exceptions even when another prime certifies the characteristic-zero instance. A conjectural slope-four valuation law could turn that bounded signal into a uniform argument, but it is still open. The public package contains three papers, exact code and data, ordinary and optimized replay receipts, negative controls, claims, reviews, provenance and checksums. Internal review passed after repair, but internal review, replay, hashes, a DOI and publication are not independent mathematical validation. The most useful next work is an integral or Smith-form proof of the slope law, finite-field norm coprimality, a uniform elimination or saturation certificate across the residual quartic charts, and unaffiliated specialist reconstruction. This audio briefing is a communication aid, not additional evidence.

problem.name: Lewis--Perry--Straub approach to the Polydegree Conjecture

keyResults: A complementary-minor congruence and inverse-coordinate descent compress the second LPS radical-membership obstruction to a fixed-width adjacent-flag problem.
For d=5, the companion separates the centered staircase ideal from the backward p-adic ideal and verifies their bridge only on the chart where the explicit transition determinant is a unit.
The repaired logic distinguishes transversality from emptiness and zero-dimensional initial-ideal evidence from saturation or radical membership.
A p-adic certificate theorem and degeneration identity support twelve designated-prime instances through n=57, while n=15 records a designed exceptional-prime diagnostic.
Ordinary and optimized replay pass the same 20 selected predicates with matching outputs; five receipt mutations and three fail-open p-adic sentinels are rejected.
evidence: A 10-page structural paper, 9-page computational companion and 4-page p-adic addendum with accessible Markdown; 22 indexed formal statements, 13 catalogue rows, 11 bounded rows, five open obligations and five non-claims; exact structural, quartic and p-adic code and data; paired normal and optimized 20-check receipts with matching output hashes; five semantic receipt mutations and three fail-closed contract controls; a complete 189-payload-file manifest; frozen v0.1.0 lineage; a five-role substantive review, response matrix and bounded confirmation report; a fresh-extraction ten-gate publication preflight; GitHub CI; and byte-matched GitHub and Zenodo assets. These establish availability, producer-side replay, integrity and internal editorial closure, not the truth of the open uniform argument or independent mathematical validation.
statusDetail: Anonymous, unrefereed structural and exact-computation candidate. Written determinant and reduction arguments are presented for expert checking; selected quartic and p-adic predicates have producer-side exact replay. The first frozen successor received Major Revision from all five internal roles and was repaired. A bounded confirmation found no unresolved P0 or P1 publication blocker. The centered and backward gauges are identified only after localization; transversality is not promoted to emptiness and zero-dimensionality is not promoted to saturation. No unaffiliated rerun, independent implementation, proof-assistant formalization, external specialist review, journal peer review or absolute priority determination has occurred. The package does not prove any of the five target conjectures.
